permissions.claim_scope: Preparation reads scene membership, source roles and physical ID metadata solely to export admissible Practical received IQ, excluding clean and older U physical packets. Estimation reads only post-Practical U/one current V packet and frozen prior. R07 truth loaded only by scorer after complete predictions.

checkpoint.initialization: Same frozen pilot and noise basis as prior. Sparse relative targets use offline joint reconstruction from other Practical received views. Dense reference and held evaluation proxy unchanged.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Train on exact same 4096 receive-only U records, choose ridge with fixed 192 U holdout and no test access. Two arms selected independently within the same fixed ridge choices.

execution.gpu_policy: Single CPU thread for fit/inference and per-packet latency. No GPU.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on input contract, numeric failure, estimator output completeness or wrong scorer closure.
